name: Chickpeas (Garbanzo)
siboNotes: High in galactans (GOS) which can trigger SIBO symptoms. Start with very small portions (1-2 tablespoons) if tolerated during maintenance phase.
preparationTips: Rinse canned chickpeas thoroughly to reduce excess sodium
Soak dried chickpeas overnight and cook thoroughly to improve digestibility
Start with small portions and gradually increase if well-tolerated
Consider chickpea flour as alternative for baking in small amounts
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of magnesium and potassium
